_comment: Tool settings. Relative paths are relative to the tool folder. Per-machine overrides: config/config.local.json (same keys, git-ignored) or CHARGEN_COMFYUI_URL / CHARGEN_COMFYUI_ROOT. A consuming project overrides output_root and defaults through its character-generator.project.json (see docs/integration.md). comfyui.extra_args only apply when this tool starts ComfyUI itself; --reserve-vram 1.5 keeps headroom for the desktop so a full card does not stall in the VAE decode.

defaults._comment: size = canvas height in px; char_height_ratio = body height / size (same scale for every character); feet_margin = empty rows below the feet; colors = palette size; outline_color = black | darkest; proportions = realistic | player.

rig._comment: Rig data step (character-generator rig): SDPose joints, part map, hidden-pixel underlay. Radii are shares of the figure height at the 1024 px source. held_item_max_gap_px = the widest gap (sprite pixels) bridged between a hand and the item it holds, so the item stays attached when the arm moves.
rig.inpaint_positive_hint: plain torso, clothing continues, no arm in front of the body
rig.inpaint_negative_hint: (arm:1.4), (hand:1.4), (sleeve:1.2), (fingers:1.2), holding, weapon in front of the body
